defs.def: an important official job that a person or group of people is given to do, especially when they are sent to another country 官方使命；使团的使命

ex.s: A big part of my mission is to get people of all ages off sugary drinks,” Tom explains.
ex.t: 我的使命的一个重要部分是让各个年龄段的人远离含糖饮料，"Tom解释说。

defs.def: a group of people doing such a job; the place where they work 使团；代表团；执行任务的地点
the work of teaching people about Christianity, especially in a foreign country; a group of people doing such work （尤指在海外的）传教，布道；布道团

ex.s: When kids mess up, don’t jump in with a rescue mission. ____39____
ex.t: 当孩子搞砸时，不要立刻出手相救。____

ex.s: This stranger became my cheerleader, as if it was his mission to lift me up from my  28 .
ex.t: 这位陌生人成了我的啦啦队长，仿佛他的使命就是把我从28 中拉起来。

ex.s: In the movie Mission Impossible, Tom Cruise made being a secret agent seem like the coolest job ever.
ex.t: 报名参加两周特工训练营的营员可以通过彩弹场上的策略学习和军事技能训练了解真实特工的生活。

ex.s: The WHO-China Joint Mission on Covid-19 held a press conference.

defs.def: a building or group of buildings used by a Christian mission 布道所；传教区
particular work that you feel it is your duty to do 使命；天职
an important job that is done by a soldier, group of soldiers, etc. 军事行动

ex.s: “If we're successful,” their mission statement reads, “we believe this will be one of the most important and widely beneficial scientific advances ever made.”
ex.t: "如果我们成功的话，"他们的使命声明写道，"我们相信这将是迄今为止最重要、最有益的科学进步之一。"

defs.def: a flight into space 太空飞行任务

ex.s: He was the commander of the Apollo 11 manned lunar landing mission, and was the first man to step on the lunar surface.
ex.t: 他是阿波罗11号载人登月任务的指挥官，也是第一个踏上月球表面的人。

ex.s: In 1944, Saint-Exupéry left on a wartime mission over occupied France, from which he never returned.
ex.t: 1944年，圣埃克苏佩里出发执行一次飞越被占领法国上空的战时任务，从此再也没有回来。

ex.s: It is an independent, non-profit organisation whose mission is to provide medical care to those affected by conflict, epidemics, disasters or a lack of access to health care.
ex.t: 它是一个独立的非营利组织，其使命是为受冲突、流行病、灾难或缺乏医疗服务影响的人们提供医疗护理。

ex.s: My mission was to relieve Emma, a Canadian specialist in infectious diseases at the end of her posting.
ex.t: 我的任务是接替艾玛，她是一名加拿大传染病专家，任期即将结束。

ex.s: Encouraged by discoveries over the years, space agencies of various countries are planning manned missions to Mars that could take place within the next 25 years.
ex.t: 受多年来发现的鼓舞，各国航天机构正在计划在未来25年内执行的载人火星任务。

defs.def: a task or journey that is very difficult and takes a long time to complete （极其艰巨且需长时间才能完成的）任务，旅行
